Callout.Name: Fireworks Complaint
Callout.Message: Fireworks being set off in a residential street.
Callout.Advisory: Group of four, fireworks in a bin, no injuries.

Script.Line: They are fireworks. It is a birthday.
We are doing it in the street because the garden is too small.
There is one left. I will put it down, look, I am putting it down.

Lines.Approach: Four of them letting them off down the middle of the road. Somebody will lose a hand at this rate.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
